summary.headline: Warnings on Illness and Weather
summary.text: Astrological warnings on illness, death, physicians, and weather: malefic planets afflicting the ascendant or sixth and eighth houses indicate disease or death, while Mercury’s strength promises recovery. Lunar applications to Venus, Mars, Mercury, Jupiter, the Sun, and Saturn predict rainfall, wind, snow, darkness, and air quality; al-Tusi is cited on the validity of these configurations.
